name: IT
fix_description: mintToPoolIfNeeded mints tokens directly to the pair on each buy to limit price increase to 1%. However, repeated small buys each trigger minting, causing excessive token inflation in the pair. Fix by adding a cumulative mint cap per time period, or removing the auto-mint mechanism entirely.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC involves a long multi-contract attack chain with nested V2/V3 flash liquidity, LP mint/redeem flows, vault deposits, lending market enter/exit logic, and collateral/borrow manipulation across several fTokens. Reproducing it requires deep protocol-specific understanding of Midas accounting and market interactions rather than spotting a simple bug pattern.
